entities.summary: Hajji Jabagh Qazanoqo was a Kabardian Circassian Islamic scholar, jurist, philosopher, poet, and diplomat. As the chief qadi and advisor to the Supreme Prince of Kabardia, he was known for his reforms reconciling Adyghe Xabze with Sunni Islam as well as his support for Pan-Caucasianism, inspiring the Sheikh Mansur movement and laying the ideological foundation for the Mountanious Republic.

entities.summary: Hajji Jabagh Qazanoqo was a Kabardian Circassian Islamic scholar, jurist, philosopher, poet, and diplomat. As the chief qadi and advisor to the Supreme Prince of Kabardia, he was known for his reforms reconciling Adyghe Xabze with Sunni Islam as well as his support for Pan-Caucasianism, inspiring the Sheikh Mansur movement and laying the ideological foundation for the Mountanious Republic.
